message: 漢の生き様

name: Soltia
message: 「N-No way... It can't be, this is...」

name: Soltia
message: 「I'm going to be reborn through Re-Crea...」

name: Macaron
message: 「That's wrong, you can't do that...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Sacrificing everyone around you just for your own sake...」

name: Soltia
message: 「I don't want to disappear as a half-baked existence that's only loathed and shunned...」

name: Soltia
message: 「Staying all alone like this... No, I don't want that... Not like this...」

name: Synn
message: 「Soltia...」

name: Melilot
message: 「So you were longing for companions as well」

name: Soltia
message: 「Compan... ions...」

name: Melilot
message: 「You may be lonely right now」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, can you truly say that all of it is the fault of your circumstances and those around you?」

name: Soltia
message: 「A lecture, now of all times...」

name: Synn
message: 「If only we had met under different circumstances...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sure even we could have come to understand each other」

name: Soltia
message: 「Demon Lord...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Start over from the very beginning, by being born once more in the Demon World」

name: Melilot
message: 「And when you do, search for a new way to live」

name: Macaron
message: 「So that the next time we meet, we can become friends, okay?」

name: Soltia
message: 「...Yeah」

name: Soltia
message: 「Next time, just being an ordinary teacher might not be so bad, huh...」

name: Synn
message: 「...Ms. Sengen'in」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Sakura-kun」

name: Melilot
message: 「There is no need for you to let this weigh on your heart」

name: Synn
message: 「But Soltia...」

name: Melilot
message: 「It is not as though she has died.」

name: Synn
message: 「Really...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Demons who exhaust their power in the Human World turn into particles of magic and are resummoned to the Demon World.」

name: Melilot
message: 「There, the particles slowly gather back together and regain their original form.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Therefore, she has not completely vanished from this world.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Though it takes a super long time to recover.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」
So that means we really might be able to see her again someday...

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, that's right! Miss Melilot!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes?」

name: Synn
message: 「Miss Melilot, um... are you a Demon?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. I had not mentioned it yet, had I?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Brother, you're only noticing now?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Helena has known from the start... so there is no particular need to hide it.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I was once called Nibe, one of the Seven Demon Generals...」

name: Melilot
message: 「...or so I was known.」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, I would appreciate it if you continued to treat me as Melilot the librarian, just as before.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes...」
Either way, I guess that means we have a reliable ally...
Everyone's going to be surprised again, though.

name: Pasta
message: 「...Did you defeat Soltia, nya?」

name: Synn
message: 「Pasta!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Where's Mr. Arden?!」

name: Pasta
message: 「That idiot... became a star, nya」

name: Pasta
message: 「He shone so brightly, and with that ugly smile still on his face, he vanished, nya...」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I see...」
Still, Arden protected Pasta all the way to the very end.
As proof of that, Pasta is safe and sound.
That broad back of his was far more noble than someone like me could ever be.

name: Macaron
message: 「You don't need to worry, it's going to be okay!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Arden just went back to the Demon World, after all」

name: Macaron
message: 「So I know you'll definitely see him again someday, Pasta!」

name: Pasta
message: 「I-It's not like I ever want to see that idiot again anyway, nya」

name: Pasta
message: 「It's just bothering me that I missed my chance to thank him, nya...」

name: Pasta
message: 「Really, *sniff*... that's all it is, nya...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah, it's okay. It's alright to cry」

name: Pasta
message: 「Ugh... I'm not... *sniff*... crying, nya... ugh...」

name: Macaron
message: 「There, there...」
I wonder if Arden's feelings got through to her...

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes?」

name: Melilot
message: 「It looks like everyone over there is safe」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Heeey, Shiiin!」

name: Ria
message: 「Is everything okay over there--?」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone... thank goodness...」

name: Melilot
message: 「You must be exhausted today」

name: Melilot
message: 「Let's save the detailed discussions about what comes next for another day, and get plenty of rest for now」

name: Melilot
message: 「I will take care of reporting to Helena as well」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes... Thank you for your consideration, and I'm sorry for the trouble」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please don't worry about it」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's go, Macaron, Pasta」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah!」

name: Pasta
message: 「*Sniffle*...」

name: Pasta
message: 「Hmph, nya. Don't boss me around, nya!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even so...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Macaron's growth truly is remarkable...」

name: Melilot
message: 「To think she could go toe-to-toe with Soltia of all people without a medium...」

name: Melilot
message: 「It seems I have one more thing to investigate...」
